result.stdout:
ampleo-apigen — generate typed AmpleoCRM entity classes from a tenant's metadata.

Usage:
  ampleo-apigen --url <baseUrl> --api-key <ampk_…> [--out <dir>] [--namespace <ns>] [--entities a,b,c]

Options:
  --url             AmpleoCRM base URL (e.g. https://api.ampleo.dk)
  --api-key         Tenant API key (X-Api-Key).
  --out             Output directory (default: Generated)
  --namespace       Namespace for generated code (default: Ampleo.ApiClient.Generated)
  --entities        Comma-separated entity system names to limit generation (default: all readable)
